title: 第一卷 第23章 我有位擅长炼丹的好友第一卷 第24章 七十二变青春版
content_zh:
明日复明日，明日又复明日。
如此，过了三日。
陈玄在荒村里找了个相对不那么破的院子，将原主人家的东西一股脑丢到对面倒塌的屋子里。
整整花费三天时间才打扫干净。
各种破烂堆满了对面半截屋。
俨然成了垃圾场。
“哎呦，累死我了……有这么个荒村就是得劲儿，住了这么久连个人影都没见过，而且还想住哪儿就住哪儿。”
陈玄杵着腰站在院中，看着自己的杰作满意点头。
看看这充满自然美感的屋檐，再看看那古朴沧桑雕花的墙皮，最后瞧瞧花枝遍地的院落，这就是大自然鬼斧神工加上自己妙手修饰的完美院落啊！
当然这只是陈玄自己眼中的景象。
事实上是：屋顶长满苔藓、墙皮掉了一大片、满院野花野草……
不重要，最起码住的问题暂时解决了。
斯是陋室，惟吾德馨。
距离上次去灵宝镇，已经过去将近一旬。
买的炼丹材料已经用得差不多了，该去补充些更高级的炼丹材料，尝试炼制更高质的丹药，比如金骨丹之类，修行起来也能更快些。
‘九阳真火诀’已小成。
修习地阶法术虽一定程度上能加快修行速度，但比之前磕药修行还是慢了许多。
将近十日连炼气后期的门槛都没摸到，反倒是‘混沌炼神决’触碰到了第一层。
修习混沌炼神决之后，虽还在炼气境，但神念已不输任何同境界炼气士，静心打坐时，能感知到方圆一里左右范围。
任何动静都能及时察觉。

至于‘归元隐气诀’却是还没来得及修行。
但这个不着急，以他现在隐藏修为的能力，已经能瞒过大部分同境炼气士，要是碰上能看破他修为的，也必然是打不过的，跑就对了。
现在炼药材料用完了，他准备再去一趟灵宝镇。
此前也做了个决定，便是福临丹阁掌柜的提议，不乏为一条赚灵晶的路子。
以现在的炼丹熟练度，虽不敢保证真能炼制出成型的聚灵丹，但炼制废丹应该问题不大。
再经由陶罐一强化，转手换灵晶，再以‘灵晶再生计划’强化灵晶，都有望打造一座灵气充沛的世外桃源。
念及此处，陈玄喜从心来。
检查了一遍携带的法宝，确定冰凝珠、隐遁蝉衣都能正常运转，然后取出上次击杀的那个倒霉蛋的储物袋。
这段时间一直忙于炼丹，还没来得及查看袋子里的东西。
将储物袋里的东西全部取出，灵晶丢进陶罐，符箓和白色珠子握在手里。
先是翻看了一遍符箓，总共有十二张，其中五张神行符，七张火爆符。
“符箓倒是杀伐和逃遁效果都不错的工具，使用起来也简单方便，以后得想办法多搞一点，最好能自己再研习一下。”
说着，捻起一张火爆符，注入灵力丢出。
只听轰的一声，符箓燃起一团火焰瞬间炸开，在对面墙壁上留下烧灼的痕迹。
“就是这威力确实不怎么样。”
应是画符之人造诣不高，导致这张火爆符威力大打折扣，连一堵墙都炸不倒。
content_en:
Tomorrow comes tomorrow, and tomorrow comes tomorrow.
So, three days passed.
Chen Xuan found a relatively unshabby yard in the deserted village and threw all the belongings of the original owner into the collapsed house opposite.
It took three days to clean it up.
All kinds of junk filled the opposite half of the house.
It has become a garbage dump.
"Oh, I'm so exhausted... It's so exciting to have such a deserted village. I haven't even seen a single person after living there for so long, and I can live wherever I want."
Chen Xuan stood in the courtyard with his waist bent, looking at his masterpiece and nodding with satisfaction.
Look at the eaves that are full of natural beauty, then look at the simple and time-carved walls, and finally look at the courtyard filled with flowers and branches. This is the perfect courtyard decorated by nature's miraculous craftsmanship and your own skillful hands!
Of course, this is just the scene in Chen Xuan's own eyes.
In fact: the roof is covered with moss, a large piece of wall covering has fallen off, and the yard is full of wild flowers and weeds...
It doesn't matter, at least the housing problem has been solved for the time being.
This is a humble house, but I am virtuous.
It has been nearly ten years since the last time I went to Lingbao Town.
The alchemy materials I bought have been almost used. It’s time to replenish some higher-level alchemy materials and try to refine higher-quality elixirs, such as the Golden Bone Pill, so that you can practice faster.
The ‘Nine Yang True Fire Technique’ has been completed.
Although practicing earth-level spells can speed up your practice to a certain extent, it is still much slower than the previous practice of taking medicine.
For nearly ten days, I didn't even touch the threshold of the late stage of Qi refining. Instead, the 'Chaos God Refining Art' touched the first level.
After practicing the Chaos Divine Refining Art, although I am still in the Qi Refining Realm, my spiritual thoughts are no longer inferior to those of any Qi Refiner in the same realm. When meditating quietly, I can sense a radius of about one mile.
Any movement can be detected in time.
As for the 'Guiyuan Hidden Qi Technique', I haven't had time to practice it yet.
But don't worry about this. With his current ability to hide his cultivation, he can already hide it from most Qi practitioners in the same realm. If he encounters someone who can see through his cultivation, he will definitely be unable to defeat him and just run away.
Now that he has run out of ingredients for refining the medicine, he is planning to go to Lingbao Town again.
A decision had been made before, and the suggestion from the shopkeeper of Fulindan Pavilion was a way to earn spiritual crystals.
With the current level of proficiency in alchemy, although there is no guarantee that the spirit-gathering elixir can actually be refined, there should be no problem in refining the waste elixir.
After strengthening the clay pot, changing hands to the spiritual crystal, and then strengthening the spiritual crystal with the "Spiritual Crystal Regeneration Plan", it is expected to create a paradise full of spiritual energy.
Thinking of this, Chen Xuan was filled with joy.
He checked the magic weapons he carried to make sure that the Ice Condensation Bead and the Hidden Escape Chanyi were functioning normally, and then took out the storage bag of the unlucky guy he killed last time.
I have been busy refining alchemy during this period, and I haven't had time to check the contents of the bag.
He took out all the contents of the storage bag, threw the spiritual crystal into the clay pot, and held the talisman and white beads in his hand.
First, he looked through the talismans. There were twelve in total, including five divine talismans and seven explosive talismans.
"The talisman is a tool that is very effective in killing and escaping. It is also simple and convenient to use. I will have to find ways to make more of it in the future. It is best to study it myself."
As he spoke, he twisted up a fiery talisman, injected spiritual power into it, and threw it out.
With a bang, the talisman ignited a ball of flame and exploded instantly, leaving burning marks on the opposite wall.
"It's just that the power is really not that great."
It must be that the person who drew the talisman was not very skilled, which caused the power of this explosive talisman to be greatly reduced, and it could not even blow down a wall.
